slot_schema.allowed_scope: data/annotation use, preprocessing, keypoint target/loss expression, identity rejection policy
forbidden: increasing network size/capacity without a diagnosed capacity bottleneck
segmentation or new heads without a diagnosed representation gap
stacking decision thresholds or tuning tau on validation beyond the frozen freeze procedure
changing the evaluation metric or denominators to improve the number
using the old exploratory final pool for tuning
slot_schema.expected_effect: which diagnosed failure mode it should move and why

budget.unit: complete training run (train start -> final epoch, one seed, one recipe)

pilot.note: 15 epochs sits inside the preregistered warmup; the pilot is a footprint/trend probe, not a model-selection result; pilot metrics are logged only

promotion_gate.authority: lead instruction 2026-11-04 + configs/perception/landmark_improvement_gate_v1.json (sha 7c81ae51...); the stricter +0.08 / joint>=0.60 rule governs advancement to the full budget
promotion_gate.rule: advance at most one candidate to the full budget only if ALL hold:
conditions: validation joint narrow-primary improves by at least +0.08 absolute versus the matched v4 pilot baseline
identity high-confidence false-match rate does not worsen versus the baseline
promotion_gate.otherwise: STOP the route version: report the negative result with root-cause evidence; no full training
promotion_gate.registered_delta: gate file pilot_advance_gate lists +0.05; the lead 2026-11-04 clarification requires +0.08 and joint>=0.60 for the same step, recorded here as a stricter pre-registered rule

full.note: all three seeds are reported including the worst; selection is validation-only

budget.accounting: lead 2026-11-04 final counting rule: pilot runs are NOT counted as complete training runs; complete trainings (up to 60 epochs each) total <= 4 = v4 baseline rerun (1) + winning candidate up to 3 full seeds. Therefore at most 2 candidate pilots, then either the winner's 3 seeds or STOP after the baseline + no winner. Pilots are trend probes only.

stop_rule.rule: warmup 15 epochs never stop; patience 20 counted from the first evaluation after warmup
stop_rule.evidence_for_rule: 2026-11-04 v1 bounded run was stopped at epoch 24 by ultralytics' internal patience counting from a warmup epoch (protocol violation, run discarded)
stop_rule.warmup_note: a 15-epoch pilot sits entirely inside warmup: its val numbers are a trend probe, not a selection result

identity high-confidence false-match rate <= baseline at the frozen validation threshold

holdout.on_fail: STOP this route version: no new holdout capture and no new test; deliver failure diagnosis, root-cause evidence and a route recommendation instead

worst seed of the full budget, not only the best
